title: What's Your Disaster Survival Style?
description: Discover how you'd really handle emergencies and disasters

questions.text: There's a zombie apocalypse starting right now. What's your first move?

options.text: Rally my friends and find a safe location
Head to the nearest grocery store for supplies
Try to save as many people as possible
Call my family and make sure everyone's safe

questions.text: You're trapped in a burning building with three strangers. What do you do?

options.text: Take charge and organize an escape plan
Look for the quickest way out for yourself
Help the most vulnerable people first
Try to keep everyone calm and work together

questions.text: A meteor is heading toward Earth. You have 24 hours. What's your plan?

options.text: Organize a global emergency response team
Secure supplies and find the best shelter
Spend time with loved ones, making final memories
Spread hope and try to unite people

questions.text: You're lost in a forest with no phone signal. It's getting dark. You...

options.text: Try to find higher ground to see the stars for direction
Build a shelter and start a fire to survive the night
Yell for help and hope someone hears you
Stay put so search teams can find you

questions.text: A massive earthquake hits while you're at work. What's your immediate reaction?

options.text: Help colleagues evacuate in an orderly manner
Duck under sturdy furniture and assess the situation
Run back for someone who can't move quickly
Check on everyone's emotional state first

questions.text: Your car breaks down in a dangerous neighborhood at night. You...

options.text: Call for help and wait, but stay alert
Walk to the nearest lit public place
Hitch a ride from a stranger (desperate times)
Message someone to stay on the phone with you

questions.text: A deadly virus is spreading. The government announces a lockdown. You...

options.text: Create a community support network for your neighborhood
Stockpile essentials and prepare to hunker down
Volunteer at a hospital or help frontline workers
Check on elderly neighbors and offer to get their groceries

questions.text: Your flight is experiencing severe turbulence. The pilot announces an emergency. You...

options.text: Stay calm and memorize the emergency procedures
Focus on securing your own oxygen mask first
Help the person next to you who looks panicked
Hold hands with your seatmate and pray together

questions.text: You wake up to find your apartment flooding. Water is rising fast. You...

options.text: Turn off electricity and try to save belongings
Grab essentials and get to higher ground immediately
Check if neighbors need help escaping
Call everyone you know for help and updates

questions.text: A shark attacks while you're swimming in the ocean. What's your response?

options.text: Stay calm and slowly swim back to shore
Fight back aggressively if it gets close
Scream for help from nearby swimmers
Make yourself as small and still as possible

leader.title: The Crisis Leader
leader.description: You shine in emergencies! While others panic, you take charge and organize people toward survival. Your natural leadership kicks in when it matters most. You're the person others look to for direction during chaos.

survivor.title: The Pragmatic Survivor
survivor.description: You're a survival machine! In crisis mode, you focus on practical solutions and self-preservation. You stay calm, think clearly, and know exactly what to do. You're prepared for anything life throws at you.

hero.title: The Brave Hero
hero.description: Danger makes you heroic! When disaster strikes, your first instinct is to help others, even at personal risk. You have a strong sense of duty and can't stand by while others suffer. You're the one who runs toward danger.

diplomat.title: The Compassionate Diplomat
diplomat.description: In emergencies, you prioritize people over tasks. Your strength is emotional intelligence—you keep others calm, connected, and cared for. While others act, you nurture. You're the heart that holds groups together.
